title: Autumn Winery Walk 2026
summary: Guided 10 km walk along the historic rail trail from Red Hill to Merricks, passing five wineries (Lindenderry, Foxeys Hangout, Paringa Estate, Stonier, and finishing at Merricks General Store with Baillieu and Elgee Park). Includes tastings and canapés along the route; light lunch at finish. Return
description: Guided 10 km walk along the historic rail trail from Red Hill to Merricks, passing five wineries (Lindenderry, Foxeys Hangout, Paringa Estate, Stonier, and finishing at Merricks General Store with Baillieu and Elgee Park). Includes tastings and canapés along the route; light lunch at finish. Return bus to Red Hill. Hosted by Mornington Peninsula Wine. All-weather event.
accessibilityNotes: Mostly gentle terrain; one steeper section; unsuitable for wheelchairs or mobility aids
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill wineries; Red Hill Recreation Reserve; Red Hill Show Grounds
suggestedItineraryPairing: Depart early departure group at 8 am; pair with Red Hill village lunch or cellar door visit
